text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Space(x) ::: x is space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a duster.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
DoesntSuck(x) ::: x doesn't suck.

Premises:
Plunger(x) ∧ Suck(x) ::: Plungers suck.
Vacuum(x) ∧ Suck(x) ::: Vacuums suck.
Vampire(x) ∧ Suck(x) ::: Vampires suck.
Space(x) ∧ Vacuum(x) ::: Space is a vacuum.
Duster(x) ∧ HouseholdAppliance(x) ∧ ¬Suck(x) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.

Conclusion:
Space(Space) ::: Space sucks.
